words.gloss: in the execution of defensive action

literal: At the battlefront enemies to perish, in the execution of action triumph having attained, that which is excellent is the fortress.
translation: An excellent fortress is one that enables its defenders to achieve triumph in their operations, causing the enemies to perish at the very battlefront.
modern: போர்க்களத்தில் பகைவர்கள் அழியும்படி, தன் பாதுகாப்புச் செயல்பாடுகளில் பெருமை பெற்று விளங்குவதே சிறந்த அரண் ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate purpose and excellence of a fortress. A true fortress is not merely a passive barrier; it must actively facilitate the military operations of its defenders. By enabling the defenders to achieve triumph in their strategic actions, it ensures that the invading enemies perish right at the battlefront. Thus, the greatness of a fort lies in its active contribution to victory.
